description: Look at one place in a JSON file in your workspace, depth levels at a time; bigger parts are folded: objects as {type: object, keys: [...]}, arrays as {type: array, counter_items: N}, long strings cut. Start at the top (pointer empty), then append the key you want to the pointer and call again, level by level. pointer is a JSON pointer, e.g. /states/think. Errors: PathBad, FileMissing, FileBad, PointerBad, PointerMissing.

path.description: the JSON file, relative to your workspace

pointer.description: where to look, a JSON pointer; empty string = the whole file (default)

depth.description: how many levels to expand (default 1, at most 10)
